infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Circle Support Health needs camera access to photograph documents and prescriptions.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Circle Support Health does not access your contacts. This message is required by iOS because a third-party library included in the app bundle references the Contacts API; the app itself does not read, transmit, or store any contact information.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Circle Support Health needs photo library access to upload health documents.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Circle Support Health uses Face ID to securely unlock your health information.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Circle Support Health reads your activity, heart rate, and sleep data to show a personalized daily health summary.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Circle Support Health updates your health data so your care team has the latest information.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Circle Support Health reads your calendars so all your appointments — medical, work, and personal — appear together in one view.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Circle Support Health reads and writes calendar events so you can manage all your appointments in one place. Events you create here will appear in your other calendar apps.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Circle Support Health writes calendar events so the appointments you create here appear in your other calendar apps.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Circle Support Health uses reminders so you don't miss your appointments.
infoPlist.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Circle Support Health uses reminders so you don't miss your appointments.
